footer.about: Mondapac is a Brisbane marketplace for local food sellers: halal butchers, bakers, pantry makers and more. Every product shows where it comes from, and certificates such as halal are checked by our team before a label appears. Prices include GST, and each seller shows its own delivery window and minimum order.

consent.title: Cookies on Mondapac
consent.body: We use necessary cookies to keep you signed in and remember your cart and settings. With your permission we also remember what you view and search for, to suggest products. You can change this at any time.
